messages:
Sanjay Rao: heads-up perf spike after merged r=gh/commit/2b7f4a9 — p50 token time +17% on long-seq workloads. dashboard: https://perf.redwood/compares/2b7f4a9

Eli Turner: link looks like a compile storm, compile-queue spiked at the same time. Any KV eviction numbers?

Sanjay Rao: kv_cache evictions jumped ~4x around the same window. local repro shows repeated kernel recompiles on the same hotpath (same model/seq) — compile-counts: 742 -> 3100 in 20m.

Maria Chen: I diffsed the PR, and it changes autotune seeding behaviour — previously we had a deterministic tie-breaker, the merge switches to randomized tie-breaks (autotune.seed now None/random). commit 2b7f4a9 is the suspect.

Eli Turner: that fits: nondeterministic kernel selection -> different kernels selected for identical requests -> cache key mismatch -> eviction + compile storms. Can we force a seed and repro?

Sanjay Rao: repro command I ran: 
```
./scripts/repro/run_hotpath.sh --model=gpt-medium --seq=1024 --concurrency=8 --seed=2021
```
With seed=2021 kernel choice stabilized and compile count stayed low. With seed randomized we see oscillation between 3 kernel variants and repeated compiles.

Maria Chen: quick patch idea: pin seed=42 in autotune config to restore determinism while we design a safer approach. Also add a perf guard unit-test.

ci-bot: perf/regression alert: perf-longseq job increased p50 from 120ms -> 141ms (+17%). failing builds: 8721, 8723.

Rachel Li: this is a rollout blocker for the release. We should revert the merge until we have a robust plan.

Sanjay Rao: opened revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4167 — pins seed and adds compile-count regression test.

Eli Turner: complementary change: include autotune.seed in the compile-cache key so different seeds don't collide and evict each other's artifacts. That will avoid cross-seed pollution if we ever enable randomization.

Maria Chen: caution: adding seed to cache key increases fragmentation when randomization is intentional. For now we should pin seed and make randomize opt-in behind a config + eviction-safety checks.

Rachel Li: rollout plan: revert on prod, cherry-pick deterministic-seed + cache-key decision to next release, add CI perf test gating for autotune changes.

Sanjay Rao: tagging @Rachel @Eli for revert approval, will coordinate rollback and monitoring.

Rachel Li: Approved, merging revert PR now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy started: release/2026-03-18-hotfix -> prod. rollout id: 515. watch: https://deploys.redwood/rollouts/515

infra-monitor: KV eviction rate trending back to baseline on prod within 12m of revert. Metrics: https://metrics.redwood/evictions?from=-30m

Sanjay Rao: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: design deterministic seeding strategy, decide cache-key semantics, add perf guard and a stress test for compile storms before re-enabling randomization.

Eli Turner: I'll write the RFC and own implementation.

Maria Chen: filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/2190 — "autotune seed policy and compile-cache semantics"

Sanjay Rao: closing thread for now, will publish a short postmortem with numbers and timeline.
